blocks.label: Overview
bullets: Unique Delivery Compared to Typical Gummies
paragraphs: Gummies are a popular dose form for nutritional supplements. Unfortunately, traditional gummies are often high in sugar and relatively low in nutrients requiring several per serving. This great-tasting fish oil gummy chew is a unique delivery form compared to typical gummies. It is also sugar free and sweetened with xylitol and stevia.
Supportive but not conclusive research shows that consumption of EPA and DHA omega-3 fatty acids may reduce the risk of coronary heart disease.

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: For adults and children (ages 4 & up), take 1 gummy chew daily with food.

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: Purified water, xylitol, fish gelatin, erythritol, glycerin, trisodium citrate, natural flavors, gum arabic, citric acid, ascorbic acid, mixed tocopherols, paprika extract and stevia leaf extract.
Contains fish (anchovies, mackerel, sardines, basa, tilapia).
Not manufactured with yeast, wheat, gluten, soy protein, milk, egg, shellfish or sesame ingredients. Produced in a GMP facility that processes other ingredients containing these allergens.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Consult physician if pregnant/nursing, taking medication, or have a medical condition. If you have cardiovascular disease, a blood clotting disorder, or impaired kidney function, please consult physician before consuming products with Erythritol.
Keep out of reach of children. Contains Xylitol, which is harmful to pets.
Natural color variation may occur in this product.
Store in a cool, dry place after opening.
